title: More reliable creator activity answers
impact: Delvin creator questions now reconcile saved deck links and keep current creator activity usable when individual source records need repair.

example.input: /ask question: What has aspiringspike been playing?
example.expected_output: Current creator activity and deck context without silently losing saved deck links that can be reconciled.

title: Jump from Research evidence to the video moment
impact: Research evidence timestamps now open the source YouTube video at the exact extracted moment, with an explicit watch action and a mobile-friendly tap target.

example.input: Open a saved video signal in Research and tap Watch evidence at 2:33.
example.expected_output: The source video opens at 2:33, matching the evidence offset Collectish extracted for that signal.
example.surface: Collectish web and Android hosted UI

title: Scan sale posts from Discord photos
impact: Delvin can analyze sale-post photos, recognize cards, enrich unresolved printings, and return a Collectish seller-oriented result without blocking on heavyweight image processing.

example.input: /scan-sale with one or more sale photos
example.expected_output: A queued Collectish sale analysis with recognized cards, printing confidence, unresolved-card enrichment, and seller-oriented recommendations.

title: Analyze Discord posts with Collectish
impact: A Discord message can be sent to Collectish for private or community analysis, including sale-post images shared from outside the Collectish server.

example.input: Message context menu → Analyze with Collectish
example.expected_output: Collectish acknowledges immediately, processes the selected message or images, and returns or shares the finished analysis in the appropriate Collectish context.

title: External catalyst research for card moves
impact: Causal questions like ‘Why did Baleful Strix move?’ combine Collectish market evidence and Signals with external catalyst research, then translate the result into a seller board.

example.input: /ask question: Why did Baleful Strix move?
example.expected_output: A catalyst summary with confidence/timing plus printing-level ACT NOW, WATCH, EXTENDED, and TODAY guidance.

title: Ask Delvin what changed
impact: Delvin can distinguish product-change questions from market-change questions and summarize meaningful user-visible changes instead of returning unrelated card rows.

example.input: /ask question: What changed in Delvin since yesterday?
example.expected_output: A concise list of user-facing Delvin capabilities, separated from market movement and implementation-only changes.

title: Analyze sealed purchase-list screenshots
impact: Delvin can resolve sealed products from a screenshot and evaluate acquisition economics rather than requiring a manually typed list.

example.input: Attach a sealed purchase-list screenshot to /ask and ask for the best purchases.
example.expected_output: Ranked acquisition guidance using landed price, practical/direct-first EV, ROI, liquidity, and value concentration.

title: Collector Booster trajectory questions

example.input: /ask question: What is the Collector Booster trajectory for Final Fantasy?
example.expected_output: Lifecycle stage, forecast authority by horizon, supply-confirmation state, and same-age analogs with match reasons and disagreements.

title: Cleaner named-source questions
impact: MTGStocks and TCGplayer source-specific questions retain their source semantics and the actionable MTGStocks layer collapses duplicate card-family treatments.
